summary: OSpec 1.8.20 lets resumed Goals safely request fresh design and plan reviews when imported legacy completions have no durable per-run decision, without rewriting their append-only review ledger.
new: Added compatibility recovery for changed Goal documents whose legacy review completions predate durable decision snapshots.
improved: Legacy completions still contribute to completed-round accounting while exposing unavailable convergence context instead of invented findings or decisions.
Continuous document review can issue a fresh specialist review after authoritative design or plan changes without forced recovery.
fixed: Fixed resumed Goals failing before design or plan review dispatch with an empty Unsupported review run decision error.
Kept modern missing decisions and non-empty invalid legacy decisions as hard integrity errors.
docs: Documented legacy document-review ledger migration, recovery boundaries, and the confirmed Dev Mobile scope-change failure mode.
